design.name: 化蛇
design.brief: Huashe (化蛇) of the Shan Hai Jing's Central Mountains ('a human face and a jackal's body, a bird's wings, it moves like a snake, its cry is like scolding; wherever it appears there are great floods'). A long sinuous creature about 7 m long that slithers low on its belly like a snake: a lean jackal-like body, a pair of large bird wings with slate-blue and sea-green feathers, a long eel-like tail, wet glossy fur and scales with strands of water weed, and a stern stylized mask-like face (not a realistic person) with a wide shouting mouth. ANATOMY, identical in every view: exactly FOUR short jackal legs, two front legs under the chest and two hind legs under the hips just before the body tapers into the long eel tail, all four legs short, splayed sideways and bent like a lizard's so the belly almost touches the ground; exactly two wings and one tail. The FRONT, SIDE and BACK views and the main pose must all show the same four legs (in the side view both near legs are clearly visible, front and hind). Magenta-violet thunder veins run along the spine; the open shouting mouth glows magenta (weak spot). Unsettling, fast, bringer of floods.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
